validation.input_contract: all 384 passed exact validate_input extracted from authorized serve source

isolation.note: Catalog was authored from the three allowlisted business/transport sources. Validation executes only exact_keys and validate_input from the transport source, not service runtime.

authoring_method: 96 AI-authored synthetic scenario families with four contextual or capability/intent variations each; families are assigned once to a split; no number-substitution expansion and no shared family generator across splits. The record emitter only supplies common schema metadata.
limitations: All examples are AI-authored synthetic and author-labeled; they are not real customer conversations or measured production frequencies.
The same author wrote utterances and proposed labels, so independent adjudication remains necessary; human_reviewed_current_version stays false.
Splits use distinct story families, but share the same business contract and its finite intent taxonomy, so semantic relatedness is expected and this does not establish real-world generalization.
Four variants per story are correlated; evaluation uncertainty should be computed with scene_family_id grouping.
Action and cohort quotas intentionally oversample rare, refusal, capability-boundary and pre-authentication situations; aggregate accuracy is not a production-rate estimate.
Public channel examples with no trusted contact content have no invented phone/address/email; planned knowledge examples are retrieval decisions without retrieved passages.
No trained model was run, and no score, calibration threshold, readiness, or deployment claim is made.
Status, identifiers and short histories are synthetic contextual inputs; no tool response or personal customer record was accessed.
